# Buildwise Group

> Buildwise Group is an independent, remote-first technology company. It builds AI-powered systems, intelligent agents and custom software that help businesses automate operations, serve customers better and unlock new opportunities. It works with businesses across Nigeria and internationally, has no physical office, and builds and owns its own ventures.

This file is a plain-text summary of the public website for AI assistants and other tools that read it. The website itself is the source of truth.

## What Buildwise Group does

- AI product engineering: product definition, architecture and working software for AI-native products.
- Business automation: operations and customer workflows, with human oversight where it matters.
- Custom software systems: integrated systems that connect the tools and data a team already uses.
- Product and technical advisory: clarifying the problem, testing the riskiest assumptions and shaping a practical path.
- Websites and digital experiences: fast, accessible websites and web experiences, with ongoing maintenance.
- Application & Cloud Security Review: scoped, authorised security assessments of web applications, APIs, cloud deployments and AI-enabled products, with evidence-based findings, a prioritised remediation plan and optional remediation support and verification. It is not a compliance certification or a guarantee that a system is free of vulnerabilities.

## Industry experience

Each area is labelled by where the experience comes from. Buildwise names clients only with their permission.

- Healthcare and aesthetics (client engagement): website maintenance for an aesthetics business, and work with Maya, the AI receptionist from Staff.
- Recruitment and career technology (Buildwise product): Huntly.
- Financial technology and trading tools (Buildwise product, in development): Traider.
- Business operations and automation (Buildwise product, in validation): Staff.
- Digital products and software (capability): websites, web applications and tools built in-house, including the scanner and website audit on this site.

## Ventures

- [Huntly](https://huntlyagent.com): an AI job-search assistant that helps people evaluate opportunities against their profile and prepare stronger applications.
- Traider (in development): a crypto research and trading-signals project for structuring market data. Signals are research inputs, not financial advice or a promise of returns.
- Staff (in validation): an applied-AI employee platform being developed and validated for business workflows such as enquiries and bookings.

## Services

- [AI automation in Nigeria](https://buildwisegroup.dev/ai-automation-nigeria): AI agents, WhatsApp automation and workflow automation for Nigerian businesses, delivered remotely; starts with an AI automation audit.
- [AI automation in Lagos](https://buildwisegroup.dev/ai-automation-lagos): the same service for Lagos businesses. Buildwise serves Lagos remotely and has no Lagos office.
- [AI agents](https://buildwisegroup.dev/ai-agents): custom AI agents for customer support, sales, enquiries and internal operations, with limited permissions, logging and human handover.
- [WhatsApp automation](https://buildwisegroup.dev/whatsapp-automation): WhatsApp assistants on Meta's official WhatsApp Business Platform for enquiries, lead qualification, bookings, notifications and human handover.
- [AI receptionists](https://buildwisegroup.dev/ai-receptionist): enquiries, appointment booking and reminders on WhatsApp and web chat; voice assessed per project.
- [Business process automation](https://buildwisegroup.dev/business-automation): workflow automation that connects existing tools and removes manual data entry.
- [Custom software development](https://buildwisegroup.dev/custom-software-development): web and mobile applications, SaaS products, internal tools and integrations.
- [AI search visibility](https://buildwisegroup.dev/ai-visibility): technical, content, structured data and authority work to help search engines and AI assistants understand a business. No guaranteed rankings or recommendations.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://buildwisegroup.dev/): services, approach, products, industry experience, frequently asked questions and contact.
- [AI Business Opportunity Scanner](https://buildwisegroup.dev/scan): eight questions that produce a rule-based report on where AI, automation or software could help a business. It runs in the browser; answers are not sent to Buildwise Group.
- [Application & Cloud Security Review](https://buildwisegroup.dev/cybersecurity): what the security review covers, how it is scoped and authorised, what clients receive, and how to request one.
- [Website & AI Visibility Audit](https://buildwisegroup.dev/website-audit): an automated, read-only check of a public website's technical SEO, robots.txt rules for search and AI crawlers, and content clarity, with evidence for each finding. It is not a guarantee of rankings or AI citations.
- [Report a security vulnerability](https://buildwisegroup.dev/security): how to report a vulnerability in this website privately, through GitHub private vulnerability reporting.

## Insights

- [Insights](https://buildwisegroup.dev/insights): practical guides to AI, automation and software for growing businesses.
- [WhatsApp AI automation for Nigerian businesses](https://buildwisegroup.dev/insights/whatsapp-ai-automation-nigeria): how WhatsApp automation works on the official WhatsApp Business Platform, what it can do, the rules to follow and how to plan running costs.
- [How to choose an AI automation company in Nigeria](https://buildwisegroup.dev/insights/choose-ai-automation-company-nigeria): a buyer's checklist with questions to ask, red flags, how to compare proposals and what a good first project looks like.
